fml.menu.mods.info.description.cartofold: One map engine for the minimap, the world map, the paper maps and the maps of the other mods.
key.cartofold.open_map: Open the map of the world
cartofold.worldmap.title: Map of the world
cartofold.worldmap.hint: Drag: move · Wheel: zoom · Right click: waypoint · Space: center
cartofold.waypoint.name: Name
cartofold.configuration.title: Cartofold settings
cartofold.configuration.minimap.tooltip: The minimap on the screen of the game.
Show the minimap. The key Y also shows and hides it.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.corner.t: The corner of the screen of the minimap.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.size.too: The size of the minimap, in units of the screen.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.zoom.too: The zoom level of the minimap, from 0 (far) to 4 (near). The keys [ and ] also change it.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.rotate.t: Turn the minimap with the player. If off, the north is at the top.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.coordina: Show the coordinates of the player under the minimap.
cartofold.configuration.minimap.waypoint: Show the waypoints on the minimap.
cartofold.configuration.worldmap.tooltip: The map of the world (key M).
cartofold.configuration.worldmap.waypoin: Show the waypoints on the map of the world.
Show the names of the waypoints
Show the names of the waypoints on the map of the world.
cartofold.layers.title: Layers of the maps
cartofold.configuration.layers.tooltip: The layers of the other mods. The "Layers" button of the map of the world also shows and hides them.
cartofold.configuration.layers.hidden.to: The identifiers of the layers that the views do not show.
cartofold.cartography.north: Move the map north (with a paper). Again: zoom out
cartofold.cartography.south: Move the map south (with a paper). Again: zoom out
cartofold.cartography.west: Move the map west (with a paper). Again: zoom out
cartofold.cartography.east: Move the map east (with a paper). Again: zoom out
